title: The importance of appropriate support and resilience in psychology - DClinPsy - Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱，还能赚到更多的钱呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr Marianne Trent），一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在正式开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将自己的专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直陪伴并支持了两届心理学家走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持礼包，无需额外支付任何费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组头脑风暴大师课、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的精美礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多详情。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的专属奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast,
sentences.zh: 在今天的《有志心理学家》播客节目中，即将为你带来的是：

sentences.en: I am guiding you through two important steps that can help you think about weathering the storm on your journey to becoming whatever type of aspiring psychologist you fancy being.
sentences.zh: 我将引导你采取两个重要的步骤，帮助你思考如何在成为你心仪的那类有志心理学家的道路上，从容应对风雨。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正立志成为一名心理学家，那就让这档节目成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast, let's go to the side, you'll be on your way.
sentences.zh: 有了这档播客的陪伴，你将顺利踏上征程。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: The first of today's Marianne Somersoundbites is all about embracing resilience.
sentences.zh: 今天的第一段“玛丽安夏日金句”的主题是：拥抱韧性。

sentences.en: Now, before you glaze over, let me tell you what that's not.
sentences.zh: 好了，在你听得走神之前，让我先告诉你它不是什么。

sentences.en: Embracing resilience is not about condemning bad or substandard treatment from others.
sentences.zh: 拥抱韧性并不意味着去默许或纵容他人糟糕的或不合格的对待。

sentences.en: And whilst you might well have heard it said that a diamond is a chunk of coal that did well under pressure, it's actually not true that diamonds are made from coal.
sentences.zh: 虽然你可能听人说过“钻石是在压力下表现出色的煤炭”，但实际上钻石是由煤炭制成这种说法并不是真的。

sentences.en: They apparently do share some of the same properties, but they are not the same.
sentences.zh: 它们显然确实共享了一些相同的特质，但它们并不是同一样东西。

sentences.en: There's loads of proverbs, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 有很多俗语，不是吗？

sentences.en: What doesn't kill you makes you stronger.
sentences.zh: 杀不死你的，使你更强大。

sentences.en: But really, you do not need to be condoning or putting up with too much stress, too much pressure.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，你真的不需要去容忍或承受太多的压力、太多的重担。

sentences.en: Too many tasks on your to-do liSt.
sentences.zh: 待办清单上有太多的任务。

sentences.en: If the temperature of the water feels too hot,
sentences.zh: 如果水温让你觉得太热了，

sentences.en: it's okay to get out and to let that be known and to think about how you can make that a more pleasant and tolerable experience for you.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择离开，把这一点明确表达出来，并思考如何让这个体验对你而言变得更加舒适和可以忍受。

sentences.en: And that's why supervision can be really useful, too.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么督导也可以非常有用。

sentences.en: Do bear in mind the free supervision shaping tool on my website, www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash supervision.
sentences.zh: 请记住我网站上的免费督导塑造工具：www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk前斜杠supervision。

sentences.en: But I think it can be useful to think about the resilience that comes from some of the natural ebb and flow that will come with our lives and that will come with any of our careers.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，思考那些伴随着我们生活以及我们职业生涯中自然起伏而产生的韧性，也是很有意义的。

sentences.en: Those ebbs and those flows, those setbacks and failures, are a really normal part of any pursuit.
sentences.zh: 那些起起落落、那些挫折和失败，其实是任何追求之路上非常正常的一部分。

sentences.en: And we can absolutely embrace the resilience that comes from viewing these challenges as opportunities for growth and learning.
sentences.zh: 我们完全可以拥抱这种韧性，那就是将这些挑战视为成长和学习的机会。

sentences.en: What does it show up for you that might give you new avenues to explore, to grow and to reduce those Achilles heels that you might have?
sentences.zh: 它在你身上展现出的特质，可能会为你开启哪些去探索、成长并减少自身软肋的新途径呢？

sentences.en: How can we use what we might learn on our journey to becoming a psychologist?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何运用在成为心理学家的旅程中所学到的东西？

sentences.en: Our stepping stones to actually help us to become a more effective psychologist in the future.
sentences.zh: 我们前行的垫脚石，实际上能帮助我们在未来成为一名更具成效的心理学家。

sentences.en: I would love your thoughts on this.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你们对这个问题的看法。

sentences.en: Do come and join the free psychology group on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 快来加入我们在Facebook上的免费心理学小组吧。

sentences.en: It is the Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这就是由玛丽安·特伦特博士创建的“有志心理学家社区”（The Aspiring Psychologist Community）。

sentences.en: Let me know what you think.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的想法。

sentences.en: I will be back along after this quick break.
sentences.zh: 稍作短暂休息后，我马上回来。

sentences.en: Hope you enjoy the jingle.
sentences.zh: 希望你喜欢这段音乐片花。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Do remember the upcoming dates for the free Compassionate Q&A.
sentences.zh: 请记住接下来免费同理心问答（Compassionate Q&A）的举办日期。

sentences.en: So as you can see on your screen, we have the first of those coming up on Monday the 4th of September 2023.
sentences.zh: 正如你在屏幕上所看到的，其中的第一场将于2023年9月4日星期一举行。

sentences.en: And that starts at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 活动从晚上6点开始。

sentences.en: A replay will of course be available too.
sentences.zh: 当然，活动也会提供回放。

sentences.en: And the best place to find the replay is Dr. Marianne Trent on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 寻找回放的最佳去处是在YouTube上搜索“Dr. Marianne Trent”。

sentences.en: The second of the sessions is Tuesday, the 3rd of October 2023, also at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 第二场答疑时间是2023年10月3日星期二，同样是在晚上6点。

sentences.en: Again, the replay is available.
sentences.zh: 同样地，也会提供回放。

sentences.en: And the third and final session to support application season for the DeclinSci, but also EdSci is also a similar time of year,
sentences.zh: 第三场也是最后一场支持临床心理学博士（DeclinSci）以及教育心理学博士（EdSci）申请季的答疑会，时间也在一年中的相近时候，

sentences.en: is going to be Tuesday, the 7th of November 2023 at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 定于2023年11月7日星期二晚上6点举行。

sentences.en: Because of the nature of podcasts and YouTube, you might well be watching this out of sequence from the order I created them.
sentences.zh: 由于播客和YouTube的特性，你收看或收听的顺序可能与我创作它们的顺序有所不同。

sentences.en: But the replays, if the dates have happened, will be available on my YouTube channel, Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 但如果日期已经过去，回放都将在我的YouTube频道“Dr. Marianne Trent”上提供。

sentences.en: And the final point for Marianne's summer soundbites for today is all about seeking support and mentorship.
sentences.zh: 今天“玛丽安夏日金句”的最后一点，是关于寻求支持和指导的。

sentences.en: It's about reaching out for support from your peers, your supervisors, from maybe even past supervisors.
sentences.zh: 这是关于向你的同伴、你的督导，甚至可能过去的督导寻求支持。

sentences.en: That's something I've always really benefited from, or other professionals in the field.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直以来受益匪浅的一点，也可以向该领域的其他专业人士寻求支持。

sentences.en: It might be that they're not psychologists, that they're people that you respect and you can grow by watching and engaging with.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不是心理学家，而是你所尊敬的人，你可以通过观察他们并与他们互动来获得成长。

sentences.en: I've always really enjoyed working closely with my CPN colleagues, and with my speech and language therapy colleagues, and even in the past physiotherapy colleagues too.
sentences.zh: 我一直非常享受与我的社区精神健康护士（CPN）同事、言语治疗师同事，甚至过去与物理治疗师同事紧密合作。

sentences.en: I believe that connecting with really like-minded people, and even sometimes people that might not be like-minded, can be transformational to us and our growth.
sentences.zh: 我相信，与真正志同道合的人建立联系，甚至有时与那些想法不尽相同的人建立联系，对我们和我们的成长都具有变革性的意义。

sentences.en: And the way that we're able to impact and affect change for the people we work with, and the clients we serve.
sentences.zh: 并且能够改变我们为合作对象和服务的客户产生影响和创造改变的方式。

sentences.en: And it's all part of the journey, you know, some of the people I've met along the way, I still think so very fondly of, and I'm still in contact with too.
sentences.zh: 这也是旅程的一部分，你知道的，我一路走来遇到的一些人，至今我仍对他们怀有深深的感激之情，并且也依然保持着联系。

sentences.en: So it's not just about tangible benefits, you know, the medals that you've acquired during your rise to being a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，这不仅仅关乎那些看得见的好处，比如你在晋升为合格心理学家的道路上获得的各种勋章。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's about the small things that stack up and give us day-to-day enjoyment.
sentences.zh: 有时，它关乎那些日积月累、为我们带来日常乐趣的点滴小事。

sentences.en: And for me, a lot of that has been with my peers and my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，其中很大一部分乐趣都来自于我的同行和同事们。

sentences.en: If you're struggling to find your tribe at the moment, or if you want to super-challenge your tribe,
sentences.zh: 如果你目前正苦于找不到自己的圈子，或者如果你想极大地挑战并提升你的圈子，

sentences.en: do consider coming along and joining the Aspiring Psychologist Membership, which is led by me.
sentences.zh: 请考虑来加入由我亲自带领的“有志心理学家会员计划”（Aspiring Psychologist Membership）。

sentences.en: You can find information about that either in the show notes by clicking on the link in any of my bios,
sentences.zh: 你可以在节目文稿中找到相关信息，只需点击我任何个人简介中的链接，

sentences.en: even on my social channels, or if you're watching on YouTube, it will be in the description with this video.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我的社交频道上也能找到，或者如果你是在YouTube上观看，它也会在视频的简介中。

sentences.en: It's £30 a month with no minimum term,
sentences.zh: 费用是每月30英镑，没有最低签约期限限制，

sentences.en: and people do say wonderful things about the membership and how helpful it has been to helping them get their foot in the door and their bums on the seats to become trainee clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 人们对这个会员计划赞不绝口，认为它在帮助他们迈入大门、成功坐上见习临床心理学家席位方面给予了巨大的帮助。

sentences.en: I hope you found this episode of Marianne's Summer Soundbites really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这期“玛丽安夏日金句”节目非常有用。

sentences.en: Well done for making the time to commit to your own learning and growth.
sentences.zh: 为自己抽空投入到学习和成长中点赞。

sentences.en: I'll be back along with the next episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一早上6点，我将带着下一期《有志心理学家》播客节目准时回归。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。
